IMP-0153.evidence_requirement: Two signals: (1) a hand-labelled 30-doc control set scores precision/recall as NUMBERS; (2) a mention-only control document yields zero candidates.
IMP-0153.question_or_target: Target: mine prose corpora (docs/, guides/, harness corpora, prompt transcripts) for described-but-never-implemented workflows. Acceptance: the extractor distinguishes USE from MENTION - a document that describes a workflow to criticize it must not be harvested as a candidate. This estate has hit use-vs-mention roughly eight times in one session, usually inside the probe itself.
IMP-0153.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot - after the second failure on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b); a win-arg-limit failure retries once with --ignore-user-config and a prompt file, never inline argv
IMP-0153.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context
tests_required: mention-only control yields 0 candidates; use control yields >=1 (both-states)
precision and recall reported as computed numbers on the labelled control set
IMP-0153.title: Build the discovery adapter for documentation, papers and session transcripts

IMP-0172.evidence_requirement: Two signals: (1) a both-sides-unique fixture is classified DIVERGED, not one-sided; (2) the diff is antisymmetric: diff(a,b) reversed equals diff(b,a) (computed).

Acceptance: the diff is DIRECTIONAL and reports both sides' unique content, because a one-directional read cannot see two-directional divergence - the measured failure mode that produced 31 data-loss-pointing misclassifications on this estate.

tests_required: both-sides-unique fixture classified DIVERGED (the exact measured blind spot)

IMP-0172.title: Implement semantic diff of two workflows over aligned stages, roles and gates
